news.title: FIFA U-20 Men’s World Cup qualifiers ready to start in Samoa
news.lede: A place on the world stage is on the line in Apia over the next two weeks as eight of Oceania’s brightest young men’s teams begin their push towards next year’s FIFA U-20 World Cup in Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan. The OFC U-19 Men’s Championship kicks off in Samoa with plenty at stake, with the two finalists qualifying for next year’s global showpiece. Coaches and captains gathered at the iconic Taumeasina Island Resort for a pre-tournament media event and photo shoot on the eve of competition. Main photo: The eight captains gather ahead of the tournament.

news.title: Adidas stock holds firm as World Cup sales lift guidance
news.lede: Adidas stock is trading below the average analyst target after a 74% jump in football-related sales and higher revenue guidance tied to the 2026 World Cup. Adidas AG (DE000A1EWWW0) stock closed at €154.20 on August 28, 2026, up 0.72 percent on 424,396 shares, while recent coverage says management kept its €2.3 billion EBIT target and raised sales guidance after a strong second quarter. The same update put the average analyst target at €204, leaving the shares well below forward expectations. Recent reporting on Adidas's latest financial update says football-related revenue rose 74 percent in the second quarter of 2026, helped by 2026 World Cup demand.

news.title: FIFA president Infantino ‘must go’, says ex-UEFA boss Platini
news.lede: AP AP https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/fyojhh/article71409586.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/WCup_IBC_Dallas_Soccer_82_11.jpg TONY GUTIERREZ FIFA President Gianni Infantino makes comments during the opening ceremony of the International Broadcast Center, Monday, June 1, 2026, in Dallas. (AP Photo/Tony Gutierrez) Platini is also suing Infantino and other FIFA officials “to seek compensation for all the damages he has suffered as a result of the tactics used to prevent him from being elected FIFA President in 2015”. Paris French football great and former head of UEFA, Michel Platini, said FIFA President Gianni Infantino “must go” following the series of events following the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Infantino has come under fire from multiple quarters since his failed plan to privatise events like the World Cup, and has seen many football bodies withdraw support for his next term.

news.title: U20 Women’s World Cup: Nigeria beat Poland in friendly -
news.lede: The Falconets of Nigeria continued their preparation for the U20 Women's World Cup with a victory against Poland (1-0) on Friday in Brzeg. Mary Mamud scored the only. Mary Mamud scored the only goal of the match in added time of the first period. Nigeria’s Falconets recorded an encouraging victory in preparation for the U20 Women’s World Cup.

news.title: Messi vs Ronaldo: Hat-trick stats compared - who has more?
news.lede: Lionel Messi‘s has scored yet another hat-trick for Inter Miami – but how does he compare to his eternal rival Cristiano Ronaldo when it comes to bagging three goals in a game? The eight-time Ballon d’Or winner netted four in Miami’s 7-1 win over Montreal, showing that age is no barrier to his class. Messi scored his first World Cup hat-trick with all three goals in Argentina’s 3-0 victory over Algeria. The first was a long-range stunner, while the third wasn’t bad either.

He’s cheering on Manchester City and Haaland in the Premier League. Odunze, entering his third NFL season, loves watching the Norwegian goal ace.

news.title: ‘Strange’—Argentina Star Slams FIFA Ban for World Cup Brawl
news.lede: FIFA handed punishments to multiple Argentina players last week for their involvement in the intense brawl that took place on the pitch after the 2026 World Cup final.
